# Sponsorship Package Builder and Pricing Calculator

> A free, browser-only tool for event organizers, creators and venues to build sponsorship tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Title or your own names), estimate what each tier is worth, set a suggested price, check cost to deliver and margin, and print a one-page sponsor sheet. No sign-up, no tracking, nothing leaves the browser.

URL: https://mizoz.github.io/sponsorship-builder/

## How the estimate works

- Tier value = sum of (impressions x CPM / 1,000) for attention items + sum of fixed dollar values (booth, tickets, speaking slot, naming rights).
- Exclusive tiers get a premium you set (25% by default).
- Suggested price = value x a multiplier you choose per tier, rounded.
- Margin = price - (cost per unit x quantity + tier fixed cost).
- All numbers are planning estimates from editable assumptions, not market guarantees.

## Default CPMs (adjustable, mostly USD benchmarks from 2025 to 2026)

| Channel | Default CPM | Impressions per unit |
|---|---|---|
| On-site signage | $5 (out-of-home $3 to $8) | attendance x days x sign views per day |
| Stage / MC mention | $20 (host-read audio $18 to $26) | attendance x share in the room |
| Social post | $8 (Meta average about $8) | followers x reach rate |
| Newsletter feature | $32 (sponsorship median about $32) | list size x open rate |
| Website logo | $3 (display average about $3) | monthly visits per month listed |

## Sanity checks it runs

- Higher tiers must cost more than lower tiers; gaps under 1.3x or over 4x are flagged.
- A higher tier should include at least everything the tier below gets.
- Negative margin or margin under 30% is flagged.
- Exclusive deliverables sold more than once are flagged.

## Outputs

Printable one-page sponsor sheet (save as PDF), markdown and plain text package, CSV, JSON import and export, named local saves and a share link.
